title: Rab29 fast exchange mutants: characterization of a challenging Rab GTPase
author: Rachel C. Gomez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bffrjjm6
materials: 4 2. MATERIALS 2.1 Purifying Rab29 and its mutants 1. His-Sumo Rab29 WT and mutants: human Rab29 coding sequence (full length) with a 6X histidine-Sumo tag flush at the N-terminus in pET15b. 2. BL21 DE3 chemically competent expression cells. 3. Luria broth (LB): 10g/L bacto-tryptone, 5g/L yeast extract, 10g/L NaCl. 4. Carbenicillin (2000X): 100mg/mL in water, stored at -20°C. 5. 1M isopropyl beta-D-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG); stored at -20°C. 6. PMSF: 100mM in 100% ethanol; stored at -20°C. 7. Protease inhibitors (100X): 100µg/ml each aprotinin, leupeptin, and pepstatin A; stored at -20°C. 8. Lysis buffer: 50mM Hepes pH 7.4, 200mM NaCl, 5mM MgCl2, 5mM imidazole, 0.5mM DTT, 20µM GTP, 10% glycerol, PMSF, protease inhibitor mix. 9. Elution buffer: 50mM Hepes pH 7.4, 200mM NaCl, 5mM MgCl2, 150mM imidazole, 0.5mM DTT, 20µM GTP, 10% glycerol. 10. Ni-NTA agarose. 11. 1ml syringe with frit at the bottom. 12. PD MiniTrap G-25. 2.2 MANT-GDP assay 1. Water bath. 2. 5X Exchange buffer: 100mM Hepes pH 7.4, 750mM NaCl, 25mM EDTA. 3. Glycerol.

steps.title: Culture and Induce Rab29 Protein
steps.instruction: Grow Rab29 constructs in LB medium and induce expression using IPTG.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate a 1L culture of LB supplemented with antibiotics using a 10ml overnight culture of each Rab29 construct grown in LB supplemented with carbenicillin.
Grow the culture at 37°C until an OD600 of ~0.6 is reached.
Transfer cultures to 18°C and induce by adding IPTG to a final concentration of 0.3mM.
Incubate at 18°C for an additional 16h.

steps.title: Harvest and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells and break them open using high-pressure homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation at 2700xg for 20min at 4°C.
Optionally resuspend the pellet in PBS, repellet, snap freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -20°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 30mL lysis buffer.
Break cells by passing once through an EmulsiFlex-C5 apparatus at 20,000psi.

steps.title: Purify Rab29 Protein
steps.instruction: Isolate Rab29 using nickel-NTA affinity chromatography and desalting.

substeps.instruction: Spin the homogenate at 13,000xg for 20min at 4°C and save the clarified supernatant.
Incubate the clarified supernatant with 30µL nickel-NTA resin (equilibrated in lysis buffer) for 2h at 4°C with rotation.
Wash the resin in the conical tube 3 times with a total of 60 column volumes of lysis buffer.
Transfer resin to an empty column (1ml syringe or larger) using 500µL of lysis buffer.
Elute Rab with 500µL of elution buffer.
Desalt the protein using a PD-10 G25 MiniTrap, collecting elution in 4 fractions.
Assay fractions for protein concentration via Bradford assay, pool the most concentrated fractions, snap freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare MANT-GDP Complex
steps.instruction: Load the Rab protein with fluorescent MANT-GDP.

substeps.instruction: Set up a 100µL reaction mixture containing 1X Exchange buffer, 5µM Rab, 8% glycerol, and 125µM MANT-GDP.
Wrap the tube in aluminum foil and incubate in a 25°C water bath for 2h.
Equilibrate a Zeba mini trap desalting column in 1X desalting buffer 10 minutes before the reaction ends.
Quench the reaction by placing on ice and adding 2µL of 2M MgCl2 (final concentration 40mM MgCl2).

steps.title: Perform Nucleotide Release Assay
steps.instruction: Monitor the release of MANT-GDP upon addition of unlabeled GDP using a plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Desalt the proteins using the equilibrated Zeba mini trap desalting column, adding the recommended 15µL stacker after sample application.
Prepare a 96-well black bottom plate on ice with 100µL final sample volume in duplicate.

Prepare control reactions with EDTA using the following 2X desalting buffers: for samples without EDTA (30mM Hepes pH 7.4, 150mM NaCl, 5mM MgCl2); for samples with EDTA (30mM Hepes pH 7.4, 150mM NaCl, 5mM MgCl2, 20mM EDTA).
Add Rab to a final concentration of 1µM and immediately begin monitoring in a plate reader (Tecan 200 Pro).
Excite samples at 360nm and monitor fluorescence at 440nm, scanning every minute and shaking before each measurement.
Wait 15-20 min until fluorescence has stabilized.
Add 2µL of 20mM GDP (final concentration 200µM GDP) or 20uL of 1mM GDP using a multichannel pipet.
Immediately return the plate to the reader and continue measurements.

steps.title: Analyze Kinetic Data
steps.instruction: Process the fluorescence data to determine nucleotide exchange rates.

substeps.instruction: Plot data in Prism, setting the last reading before the addition of unlabeled GDP as time zero.
Fit the data to a one phase decay (pseudo-first order decay) to calculate half-times.
